TheLateNeoproterozoicwasacriticalperiodinEarthhistory, ThreeNeoproterozoicpolesfromtheTarimblockhavebeenre-
foritwitnessedthebreakupofRodinia,extremeclimatechanges portedrecently(Chenetal.,2004;Huangetal.,2005;Zhanetal.,
